title: ISW Paper Revision Patch: Proposed Corrections to ISW Cross-Correlation Predictions for EFC with DESI DR1 Tracers
description: This internal note issues a minimal correction patch to the previously published ISW cross-correlation predictions for Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) with DESI DR1 tracers. It clarifies the growth-driven vs potential-driven channel interpretation, withdraws irreproducible redshift-dependent AISW values, and replaces them with a uniform AISW ≈ 0.89 ± 0.03 suppression across all bins, while retiring an inapplicable cancellation metric.

growth_rate.description: Logarithmic growth rate of linear density perturbations used in the ISW source for the growth-driven channel.

potential_growth_driven.description: Metric potential in the growth-driven interpretation; mu(a) modifies ISW only through its effect on D(a) and f(a).

potential_potential_driven.description: Metric potential in the potential-driven (MG-type) interpretation; introduces an explicit d\mu/d\ln a term in the ISW kernel.

isw_source_growth_driven.description: ISW source term under the growth-driven interpretation adopted in the patch.

cancellation_index_original.description: Original cancellation metric defined in the withdrawn analysis; declared not applicable under the growth-driven ISW channel where no K_{\mu'} term exists.

key_results.main_finding: Self-consistent growth-driven calculations predict a uniform ISW amplitude ratio of A_ISW ≈ 0.89 ± 0.03 (∼11% suppression) across all DESI DR1 tracer bins with negligible redshift dependence, replacing previously reported irreproducible values.
parameters_tested: mu(a) parameterization with beta=0.16, a_t=0.55, sigma=0.25
A_ISW amplitude ratio over l in [2,60]
datasets_used: DESI DR1 spectroscopic tracers: LRGz0, LRGz1, LRGz2, LRG+ELG, ELG, QSO
CMB temperature anisotropies (ISW), multipoles l in [2,60]

sealed_predictions.statement: For DESI DR1 spectroscopic tracers cross-correlated with CMB temperature over l ∈ [2,60], the ISW amplitude ratio is A_ISW = 0.89 ± 0.03 with negligible redshift dependence across z_eff ≈ 0.5–1.5.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: A combined multi-tracer ISW analysis yielding A_ISW = 1.00 ± 0.05 across all bins, or a significant tomographic gradient inconsistent with a uniform ∼11% suppression.

sealed_predictions.statement: The ISW signal remains positively correlated (A_ISW > 0) for all DESI DR1 bins; no anti-correlation at z_eff ≳ 0.6 under the growth-driven channel.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: A robust (>3σ) detection of anti-correlated CMB–LSS ISW cross-correlation at z_eff ≳ 0.6.

kill_criteria: KC1: A combined multi-tracer ISW measurement with DESI spectroscopic bins over l ∈ [2,60] finds A_ISW = 1.00 ± 0.05 consistently across all bins, ruling out the predicted uniform ~11% suppression and excluding the EFC growth-driven channel at >2σ.

KC2: A sustained tomographic trend inconsistent with z-independence, e.g., A_ISW ≤ 0.75 at z_eff ≥ 1.2 while A_ISW ≥ 0.95 at z_eff ≤ 0.6 (or an equivalent gradient >0.15 across 0.5 ≤ z_eff ≤ 1.5), falsifying the uniform suppression predicted by the growth-driven channel.
KC3: A statistically significant (>3σ) anti-correlated ISW signal (A_ISW < 0) for tracers with z_eff ≳ 0.6, contradicting the growth-driven ISW prediction adopted in this patch.
